blocks.text: ASPAC Rural Bank collects and uses your personal data (including identification, contact, financial and, where required by law, government-issued ID information) to open and maintain your account or loan, verify your identity, assess credit, comply with laws and BSP regulations, and protect the Bank and its customers.
We share data only with those who need it for these purposes, such as regulators, credit bureaus and service providers bound by contract.
We keep your data only as long as needed or required by law.
You have the right to be informed, to access, correct, object to, and ask for blocking or erasure of your data, and to file a complaint.
Our full Privacy Notice is displayed in our branches and at aspacbank.com website.
Contact our DPO at email: dataprotectionofficer@aspacbank.com or Phone: 09173082873.
